mechanism.who_is_forced_or_underreacts: The FORCED participant is the plan itself, not a person: a 10b5-1 sale flagged via aff10b5One is PRE-COMMITTED supply - the execution schedule was set when the plan was adopted, execution cannot be withheld in response to price or news, and the flag literally DECLARES that further scheduled executions are coming. The LATE/wrong participant is the attention-limited outside holder or dip-buyer who reads each flagged Form-4 sale as a one-off headline and under-estimates the PERSISTENCE of mechanical, price-insensitive supply: successive flagged acceptances for the same issuer are aggregated by no standard data product (the field is new, post-2023 amended schema, and truthy on only 6,215 of 80,170 tagged post-2023 docs).
mechanism.why_the_effect_exists: Discretionary insider sales concentrate adverse selection; declared-plan sales are executed for liquidity/diversification on a schedule fixed in advance, and their supply property is QUANTITY and PERSISTENCE, not timing (Jagolinzer 2009: plan executions cluster in sequences; Cohen-Malloy-Pomorski 2012: routine/plan flow is a distinct, informationally weaker class - cited as lineage of the intent axis ONLY; here the class membership is DECLARED BY THE FILER, never inferred). If headline readers cannot cheaply distinguish a scheduled drip-feed from a one-off discretionary sale, the post-filing window of high-cadence plan-flagged issuers under-reacts to remaining scheduled supply: prices drift down through the window as successive mechanical executions clear, relative to isolated-flag issuers whose declared supply is one-and-done.
mechanism.observable: fdens(e,t) = count of DISTINCT flagged acceptance sessions (trading sessions with >= 1 truthy-declared aff10b5One doc) for entity e with acceptance datetime in the trailing 63 trading days ending at decision close t. Count-based by construction: NO price, volume or value input anywhere in the exposure (price enters only through the inherited eligibility/cost machinery).
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: (i) declared-supply persistence is efficiently priced after band costs (anchor expectancy <= 0 after base costs); (ii) the sham-insider matched no-flag cohort reproduces the anchor identifying metric same-sign >= 0.5x - the flag linkage is fiction; (iii) the filing-arrival clock shadow reproduces the anchor same-sign >= 0.5x - the book was arrival/attention mass wearing a plan costume; (iv) D2 measures pooled |rho| > 0.20 vs ANY of the 15 veto entries - vol_level is the NAMED most-plausible death (plan adoption and execution cadence plausibly skew to high-volatility issuers; both V13 insider twins died exactly there at 0.232/0.2402); (v) the carried stage-A gates fail (folds, PF, MDD, SPY-excess, ETF-share, stress x2, drop-one); (vi) P2 finds the bookable-entity population (unique flagged ISSUER count and per-sector tercile mass) below the cycle's frozen decision floor - then the lane dies BLOCKED_DATA honestly.
mechanism.which_control_kills_the_convenient_expla: 'Any insider-filing book on this window mass works' is killed by the sham-insider control (matched no-flag filer cohort carrying the flag-permutation support: flags permuted within (acceptance-session, sector) cells preserving each cell's flag-count marginal exactly, destroying the flag-to-issuer linkage; full anchor machinery recomputed). 'It is just filings/attention at these names' is killed by the filing-arrival clock shadow (plain acceptance-mass book at the same dates, no flag, no direction, both orientations computed). 'It is volatility-regime sorting' is killed at D2 by the declared vol_level ancestry check on the frozen representation, fail-closed.

ancestry_defense: The dead SFV13-A4 twins measured (a) cross-sectional ranking of the NET DIRECTION of ALL open-market insider flow and (b) an INFERRED routine-vs-opportunistic process classification; this lane's information source is neither: aff10b5One is a FILER-DECLARED document-level intent field of the post-2023 amended schema (6,215 declared docs measured; canary-clean), and the exposure aggregates DECLARED future supply (execution-session cadence of flagged filings), not realized flow direction and not any inferred regularity. It is not a net-direction re-clock (no ranking of overall flow sign; the cohort is the flagged subset and the rank is persistence-of-declaration), not a CMP re-clock (no classification inferred from trading patterns - the class membership is on the document), and not a dividend-transition re-clock (no EODHD corp-action conditioning anywhere; EODHD series are the pricing leg only). The named most-plausible death is nonetheless vol_level (both V13 insider twins died there at 0.232/0.2402, and plan usage plausibly skews to high-volatility issuers): ancestry is MEASURED at D2 on the frozen representation, fail-closed, and this lane accepts the kill in advance.

falsification_rule: FROZEN before any PnL: (1) SHAM: if the flag-permutation matched no-flag sham book reproduces the anchor's identifying metric (overall risk-matched SPY-excess alpha) with the SAME SIGN at >= 0.5x magnitude, the family is DEAD. (2) ARRIVAL: if the filing-arrival clock-shadow book reproduces the anchor same-sign >= 0.5x in either pre-declared orientation, the family is DEAD. (3) ANCESTRY: pooled |rho| > 0.20 vs ANY of the 15 veto entries at D2 => BLOCKED_NOVELTY pre-score, fail-closed on unmeasured entries. (4) SELF-SUBSUMPTION: pooled anchor-vs-shadow Spearman rho >= 0.98 => DESIGN_FAILURE pre-score (the V12 0.9923 lesson - a control indistinguishable from its anchor is a design failure). (5) NEIGHBOUR opposite sign on the identifying metric => withdraw the persistence reading (support failure). (6) NO RESCUE: no threshold, universe, cost, gate, window or fold change after any PnL is visible; REJECT and BLOCKED are successful outcomes of this negative-first cycle.
expected_failure_interpretation: If the anchor is <= 0 after base costs with all controls quiet: declared-supply persistence is efficiently priced in post-filing windows - a clean scientific rejection. If D2 fires on vol_level: plan-execution cadence is a volatility-regime proxy and the declared-cadence axis closes exactly as the inferred axis closed (0.232/0.2402 precedent) - the 15-entry veto set gains a sixteenth-form lesson, not a rescue. If the arrival shadow fires: the flag carries no incremental content beyond filing mass - the declared-intent hypothesis is falsified in its convenient form. If the sham fires: the cadence spread is a distributional artifact of window mass with a sign glued on (falsification-by-control cluster). If P2 finds the unique-issuer/tercile mass below floor: BLOCKED_DATA, honestly, before any selection.
distinctness_vs_sibling: SFNG1-A4-P1 (this proposal) uses the flagged flow's OWN cadence/persistence structure (within-flagged-cohort disposition, count-based, no price input); SFNG1-A4-P2 uses the flag's INCREMENTAL content (plan-vs-nonplan CONTRAST within the same entity's sell flow, a different information source and a different book construction). Different universes (flagged cohort vs sell-flow cohort), different exposures (session cadence vs plan-share-of-sells), different arms (value-density neighbour vs identity-count neighbour) - not a parameter difference.
